formula: \mathbf F\mathbf C=\mathbf S\mathbf C\boldsymbol\varepsilon,\qquad \mathbf C^\dagger\mathbf S\mathbf C=\mathbf I

note.ja: 閉殻RHFの占有空間軌道の式。一般に非局所な交換を含む。実行例は球対称1s² Heの局所還元に限定し、一般の分子・多電子のFock行列構築は未実装。
note.en: Closed-shell RHF spatial-orbital equations, generally with nonlocal exchange. Runnable code is restricted to the spherical 1s² helium local reduction; general molecular/many-electron Fock-matrix construction is not implemented.

note.en: Representative local KS equations. Runnable code covers spherical-helium spin-unpolarized Dirac exchange-only LDA. Correlation, GGA, hybrids, generalized KS and periodic systems are not implemented.

name.en: Helium: closed-shell HF and exchange-only LDA

note.ja: 孤立・球対称・閉殻1s²に限定した原子単位の動径式。RHFのvH/2は2電子同一空間軌道に特有。LDAは交換のみで相関なし。UHF、GGA、hybrid、一般分子・周期DFTの実行例ではない。
note.en: Atomic-unit radial equations restricted to isolated spherical closed-shell 1s² helium. The RHF vH/2 form is specific to two electrons sharing one spatial orbital. LDA is exchange-only, without correlation; no UHF, GGA, hybrid, general molecular or periodic-DFT example.

reference_note.ja: 閉殻HF・交換のみLDAの独立参照、SCF残差・電子数・格子収束を確認します。近似汎関数の解を厳密なHe多体解とは呼びません。
reference_note.en: Check independent closed-shell HF/exchange-only LDA references, SCF residuals, electron number and mesh refinement. Approximate-functional solutions are not labeled exact many-body helium solutions.

method_note.ja: この問題への対応が共通の固定入力・実行例で明示された手法です。図と実行例の条件の違いは入力で確認してください。
method_note.en: Methods explicitly bound to this problem by the common fixed-input execution example. Inspect its input for differences from the figure’s conditions.

name.en: Helium: closed-shell HF and exchange-only LDA

scope.ja: Heの球対称1s²・閉殻HFとスピン非偏極Dirac交換のみLDAを比較します。電子相関・分子・周期系は含みません。
scope.en: Compare spherical 1s² closed-shell helium HF and spin-unpolarized Dirac exchange-only LDA. No electron correlation, molecules or periodic systems.

assumptions.ja: 非相対論・無限質量の点核、2電子が単一1s空間軌道を二重占有。2次中心差分と線形密度混合。HF交換の局所還元はこの2電子問題に限定。
assumptions.en: Nonrelativistic infinite-mass point nucleus, two electrons doubly occupying a single 1s spatial orbital. Second-order central differences and linear density mixing. Local HF exchange reduction is specific to this two-electron problem.

limits.ja: Heの球対称1s²・閉殻HFとスピン非偏極Dirac交換のみLDAを比較します。電子相関・分子・周期系は含みません。
limits.en: Compare spherical 1s² closed-shell helium HF and spin-unpolarized Dirac exchange-only LDA. No electron correlation, molecules or periodic systems.
